name: Buffy
description: Buffy was the name of a CLE-004 window cleaning droid that worked on the planet Coruscant with the INS-444 Mick. The two droids replaced the bedroom window of Senator Padmé Amidala's apartment after the original window was destroyed through the actions of Zam Wesell's assassin droid and Obi-Wan Kenobi.
